meta.name: qdrant-migration-tool
meta.description: Guides use of the Qdrant Migration Tool CLI to move vectors, metadata, and sparse embeddings from another vector database into Qdrant. Use when someone asks 'how do I migrate from Pinecone/Weaviate/Milvus/Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/pgvector/s3/Azure/Chroma/Redis/MongoDB/FAISS/Solr to Qdrant', 'move my vector database to Qdrant', 'is there a migration tool for Qdrant', 'my migration got interrupted, how do I resume it', 'migration is too slow', or 'collection wasn't created after migration'. Also use when picking migration batch size, deciding on `--net=host`, or verifying data after a migration.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你用 Qdrant 迁移工具这个 Docker 容器:帮你按源库选对子命令、配置本地实例、从中断处续跑、调整批次大小,并在迁移后按校验框架核对数据。
howto.when: 当你问怎么从 Pinecone、Weaviate 等向量库迁到 Qdrant,或迁移中断、太慢、结束后集合没建出来时触发。

howto.what_en: Guides use of the Qdrant Migration Tool Docker container: Claude helps pick the source-specific subcommand, run it against local instances, resume interrupted migrations, tune batch size, and verify data afterward.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask how to migrate from Pinecone, Weaviate, etc. to Qdrant, or when a migration was interrupted, runs too slow, or left no collection behind.

say_en.text: I want to migrate from Pinecone to Qdrant. Which subcommand do I use?
say_en.note: Gives the subcommand and its credential mapping guide

say_en.text: My migration got interrupted. How do I resume it?
say_en.note: Re-run the same command; progress is in _migration_offsets

say_en.text: My migration is too slow. How do I tune batch size?
say_en.note: Suggests raising batch-size from 50 to 256 or 512
